checks.evidence: 1/1 pages may be indexed and quoted (meta robots, X-Robots-Tag)

checks.name: Page structure
checks.evidence: 0/1 pages carry article-level schema.org markup · 0/1 have exactly one <h1> · median word count 25

checks.name: Quotability
checks.evidence: 0 definitional phrases, 0 hard figures, tables on 0/1 pages · English phrase lists only

actions: Publish sitemap.xml with an accurate <lastmod> on every URL and list it in robots.txt with a Sitemap: line.
Add JSON-LD that matches the visible content (Article/BlogPosting with author and dateModified, BreadcrumbList); keep exactly one <h1> per page. Use FAQPage only on pages that really are FAQs.
Add a 40-60 word definitional answer plus one hard figure or comparison table near the top of each page — that is the block engines quote.
Refresh or retire stale pages and expose an honest dateModified.
Optional: llms.txt is a proposal with no confirmed consumer among the major engines (Google says it does not use it). Publish one only if it is cheap to maintain.
